sources.title: Endothelial cell, TIRF (real data)
sources.note: spt_batch_analysis/test_data/real/Endothelial_NonBapta_bin10_crop.tif: 100 frames, 95 x 102 px. Reference = ImageJ ThunderSTORM localizations committed beside it (spt_batch_analysis/test_data/real/Endothelial_NonBapta_bin10_crop_locs.csv), shown at x_nm/108 - 0.5 (ThunderSTORM's corner origin to pixel centres).
protocol: Camera (protocol file): offset 0, photons2ADU 1, EM gain 100, pixel 108 nm, so 0.01 photons per ADU.
ImageJ settings: wavelet filter (scale 2, order 3), local maximum 4-neighbourhood, threshold std(Wave.F1), integrated Gaussian, weighted least squares, initial sigma 1.6, fit radius 3.

sources.title: Synthetic frames with ground truth
sources.note: spt_batch_analysis/test_data/synthetic/*.tif written by spt_batch_analysis/tests/synthetic/generate_synthetic_data.py (seed 42), centre 64 x 64 px of frame 1. Reference = the ground-truth positions (pixel centres).
protocol: Camera: baseline 100 ADU, 3.6 photons/ADU, EM gain 100 (so 0.036 photons per ADU after gain).
